question: Find the full names of male superheroes from Marvel Comics who have one of the top 5 highest strength attribute values and more powers than the average number of powers per superhero.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_strength AS (
    SELECT ha.XCL_009 AS hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT hp.XCL_012 AS hero_id, COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    GROUP BY hp.XCL_012
),
avg_power_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(power_count) AS avg_cnt
    FROM hero_power_counts
)
SELECT s.XCL_020
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
INNER JOIN hero_power_counts hpc ON s.XCL_018 = hpc.hero_id
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Male'
  AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.XCL_018 IN (SELECT hero_id FROM top_strength)
  AND hpc.power_count > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_power_count)

WITH top_strength AS (
    SELECT ha.XCL_009 AS hero_id
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
    ORDER BY ha.XCL_011 DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT hp.XCL_012 AS hero_id, COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    GROUP BY hp.XCL_012
),
avg_power_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(power_count) AS avg_cnt
    FROM hero_power_counts
)
SELECT s.XCL_020
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
INNER JOIN hero_power_counts hpc ON s.XCL_018 = hpc.hero_id
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Male'
  AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.XCL_018 IN (SELECT hero_id FROM top_strength)
  AND hpc.power_count > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_power_count)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH hero_powers AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name, ha.XCL_011 AS strength_value,
           COUNT(hp.XCL_012) AS power_count
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    WHERE a.XCL_004 = 'Strength' AND g.XCL_008 = 'Male' AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020, ha.XCL_011
),
avg_powers AS (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM (
        SELECT s.XCL_018, COUNT(hp.XCL_012) AS cnt
        FROM superhero s INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
        GROUP BY s.XCL_018
    )
)
SELECT full_name
FROM hero_powers
WHERE power_count > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_powers)
ORDER BY strength_value DESC
LIMIT 5

    s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN 
    publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
JOIN 
    hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN 
    attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
JOIN 
    hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
WHERE 
    g.XCL_008 = 'Male'
    AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
    AND ha.XCL_011 IN (
        SELECT ha2.XCL_011
        FROM hero_attribute ha2
        JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
        WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
        ORDER BY ha2.XCL_011 DESC
        LIMIT 5
    )
    AND (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM hero_power hp2 
        WHERE hp2.XCL_012 = s.XCL_018
    ) > (
        SELECT AVG(power_count) 
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS power_count 
            FROM hero_power 
            GROUP BY XCL_012
        )
    )
